psychological_meaning: Tory Blue is a deep, trustworthy blue that evokes feelings of stability, confidence, and authority. It's often associated with intelligence, efficiency, and responsibility, making it a popular choice for brands that want to project a sense of reliability and expertise. This color can also inspire feelings of calmness and security, creating a sense of trust and loyalty.

real_world_examples.title: Corporate Branding
real_world_examples.description: Many corporations use blues like Tory Blue in their logos and branding to convey trustworthiness and stability.

real_world_examples.title: Police Uniforms
real_world_examples.description: The dark blue of some police uniforms projects authority and instills a sense of order.

how_to_pair: Pair with neutrals like gray or white for a professional look.
Use with a warm accent color like gold or yellow for contrast.
Combine with lighter blues for a calming, monochromatic scheme.
